name: closeness_centrality
author: 7b0e9b7e
description: Ranks nodes by closeness centrality: how few steps (hops) a node is, on average, from all other nodes, found by breadth-first search from every node. Use for questions like 'who can reach everyone fastest?', 'which airport is the most central / best connected overall?' or 'who is closest to everyone in the network?'. Works on undirected and directed graphs; on directed graphs the distance is measured from the other nodes TO the node (incoming paths). Edge weights are ignored: distance is the number of edges, e.g. flights. In disconnected graphs, nodes that reach only a small part of the graph get a lower score (Wasserman-Faust scaling). Returns the top_k nodes with their closeness score (0 to 1, higher = more central) and average distance in hops.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: How many of the most central nodes to return.
